camel_example: aliyun smc TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 's-bw526m1vi6x20c6g0000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType sourceserver
description_en: You can call TagResources to create and attach tags to multiple SMC resources, such as migration sources and migration tasks
description_zh: 调用TagResources为指定的SMC资源（迁移源和迁移任务）列表统一创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun smc tag-resources --resource-type sourceserver --resource-id s-bw526m1vi6x20c6g0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SMC resource. Valid values:

sourceserver: migration source

replicationjob: migration task
parameters.help_zh:
SMC资源类型。取值范围：

sourceserver：迁移源

replicationjob：迁移任务
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SMC resource. SMC resources include migration sources and migration tasks. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: SMC资源ID。SMC资源包括迁移源和迁移任务。N的取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of tag N to add to the SMC resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It also cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http:\//或者https:\//
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of tag N to add to the SMC resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag value can be an empty string. The value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
为SMC资源指定的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。

一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value
